findings.title: _bool_from_summary 静默吞掉损坏的 result_summary JSON,影响 is_official/可执行版本/可派工判定
findings.reference_chain: _bool_from_summary 被 _history_is_executable(:36) 与 build_plan_identity(:150) 调用判 is_simulation → is_simulation 喂入 _is_official_plan(:87-95 not is_simulation) 与 latest_executable_official_version(:41) → 进而决定 is_current_executable_official_version、can_dispatch、can_write_feedback(identity_builder:163,173)。写入侧 result_summary 恒由 schedule_orchestrator.py:354 的 build_result_summary_fn 产 json.dumps;schema.sql:586 result_summary TEXT(可空)。读回 ScheduleHistory.result_summary 为原文本。
findings.why_debt: 项目灵魂线是'坏数据不准静默兜底、宁可暴露错误'。此处对损坏 JSON 直接 except→return False,把'这条历史的 summary 解析失败'当成'不是模拟'安全默认,使一条 summary 损坏的记录可能通过 _history_is_executable 被选为 latest_executable_official_version、并被判 is_official。错误被吞,不会让用户/运维看见数据缺口。
findings.blast_radius: 改成抛错可能让历史含 NULL/legacy 非JSON summary 的老库在版本身份解析处直接报错(影响面=身份解析全链);保持吞错则牺牲'坏数据可见性'。低危因 result_summary 正常恒为机器写 JSON、损坏罕见。需怀疑者判:是合理的 NULL/legacy 容忍,还是该暴露的损坏吞噬。
findings._adv_precondition: 承重的不是这处 summary 解析，而是 result_status='simulated'（由同一 ctx.simulate 原子同写、且在两个消费者里都先于/独立于 summary 被检），所以删/统一不会让模拟冒充正式或可派工——该安全护栏断言被推翻。但要动它有两条硬前提：(1) 绝不可原地改成 raise——latest_executable_official_version 全量扫历史行，任何一条 legacy/NULL 邻接的损坏 summary 都会让当前方案的 is_current_executable_official_version/can_dispatch/can_write_feedback 整链抛错，这是可用性放大事故而非安全收益；(2) 若要移除这处冗余的 summary-based is_simulation 判定，先确认没有任何写入方会在不同写 result_status 的情况下单独写 result_summary.is_simulation（当前 INSERT 是原子同写，成立）。若确实要落实灵魂线'坏数据可见'，应在读边界加一条非致命的完整性日志/计数标记出无法解析的 result_summary，而不是让版本身份解析崩溃。
_adv_evidence: schedule_plan_identity_builder.py:24-29 — flagged silent `except (TypeError, ValueError): return False` in _bool_from_summary

schedule_plan_identity_builder.py:32-38 — _history_is_executable checks Gate1 `result_status in _BLOCKED_RESULT_STATUSES {failed,simulated}` (lines 33-35) BEFORE the summary gate (line 36); every real simulation is blocked by Gate1 first
summary/schedule_summary_freeze.py:82-86 — _compute_result_status: `if simulate: return ScheduleResultStatus.SIMULATED.value` → every simulate run is forced to result_status='simulated'
summary/schedule_summary_assembly.py:437 — `"is_simulation": bool(ctx.simulate)` — derived from the SAME ctx.simulate flag as result_status (redundant copy)
summary/schedule_summary.py:216 — result_summary always = json.dumps(result_summary_obj); never hand-written, so corruption is a should-never-happen DB-tamper/legacy case

run/schedule_persistence.py:309-318 + data/repositories/schedule_history_repo.py:133-150 — result_status and result_summary written together in one INSERT (atomic co-write; they cannot diverge via the normal path)
data/repositories/schedule_plan_query_repo.py:75-118 — both list_history_identity_rows and get_history_identity_row SELECT h.result_status AND h.result_summary from the same row

schedule_plan_identity_builder.py:161-163 — `result_ok = result_status not in _BLOCKED_RESULT_STATUSES`; `is_current_official = is_official and is_current and result_ok` → result_status independently backstops the dangerous-action gate, not the summary flag

core/services/scheduler/resource_dispatch_actual_record_service.py:137,142-149 — the actual dangerous dispatch/feedback write gates on can_write_feedback + role/source/scenario recheck (requires is_current_official => result_ok), never on summary is_simulation alone

schedule_plan_identity_builder.py:41-45 — latest_executable_official_version iterates ALL history rows; converting return False -> raise would let ONE corrupt legacy row break version resolution for the CURRENT plan (availability amplification, zero safety gain)

findings.title: _normalize_role 在 schedule_plan_role 与 schedule_plan_query_service 字节级重复,且无 plan_role 归一收口点

findings.why_debt: 同一'role 归一(空→adopted)'职责的两份完全相同私有副本;schedule_plan_role 作为 model 已是天然归口,query_service 重复造一遍而非复用。属轻度 P5,改一处易漏另一处。
